Fixed NHL ML confidence pinning. Replaced conf = 2.5 + edge*20 (pinned at 5.0 for any edge >= 12.5pp) with a documented monotonic linear curve conf = 1.0 + edge*(4/0.15) over the 0-15pp sensible band, keeping the +0.3 dog and +0.3 edge>=10pp bonuses, clamped to [1,5]. Added the same saturation guard as the puck-line path: model_prob >= 0.99 / <= 0.01 OR edge > 0.15 caps conf at 3.0 and sets data_quality=saturated_model_spread on the pick. Applied to nhl-power-model.py (new shared ml_confidence_score() + ML pick entry) and both identical ML paths in edge-scanner.py (cmd_scan + cmd_card, new shared ml_confidence_score()). Verified end-to-end on today's live slate: OLD pinned 10/11 ML candidates at 5.0, NEW 0 pins at 5.0, 10 saturated (capped 3.0), 1 genuine candidate discriminated (Utah Mammoth 9.7pp edge: 4.4 -> 3.6). daily-betting-card.py --section betting renders cleanly (7 picks, 5 NHL puck-line; 0 NHL ML picks today because every ML candidate is genuinely saturated). Tests: 126 passed; 4 failures confirmed pre-existing via git stash (MMA/log-bet/scanner-pipeline, unrelated to this change). Out-of-scope note: today's card NBA local_power_ratings=error is a separate model-source bug, not touched.
